text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: We lost. My condition wasn't bad, but—

I thought she'd be furious, but when 
Sirius Symboli returned to the waiting 
room, she was surprisingly calm.

No, perhaps she's just trying her best to 
act calm. How should I speak to her?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Talk about acting high and mighty.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So what? Should I just bawl my eyes out? 
Will that make me stronger? Hell no, it 
won't.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to be jerked around by 
emotions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
From this defeat, I see what needs to be 
done. All that's left is to claw my way 
back up. That is all.

Seeing the fire in her eyes, I decided to 
do whatever I could for Sirius Symboli's 
sake.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know what needs to be done. All 
that's left is to go out there and win.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll sharpen these fangs, bite right into 
all those smug bastards, and take 'em 
down.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ain't got time to stand around. Let's 
move.

Beneath her calm exterior, I caught a 
glimpse of her running out of leeway. As 
her Trainer, I resolved to support Sirius 
Symboli with all I had.
